cells.rationale: Ember Tasks is an in-process bounded-worker coordinator, not a durable job store: terminal records are retained only in memory and discarded beyond a fixed queue. RightKit Jobs owns persisted job rows, recovery, fencing and Runner lifecycle, so there is no competing Ember implementation in its precise scope.

applicability_evidence.detail: Task map, channels and JoinHandles are process-local; completed records are capped then evicted at lines 1108-1111, proving no durable JobStore-equivalent
Workspace manifest has no cargo:rightkit-jobs dependency; source census found no JobStore, Runner or persisted job-state route

cells.remaining_work: None; evaluate RightKit Jobs only if Ember adds durable, restart-resumable jobs or cross-process job control.
